# Classroom apps by Jaben Schalk

<!-- This file is generated by public-release-tools/build-public-copy.js. Edit it there. -->

Free Google Apps Script apps for high-school English, built and used in real classrooms. Take one as is, or make your own version and change anything.

**Website:** https://jabens-pixel.github.io/classroom-apps/

|---|---|---|

## How it works

- **Make your own copy.** Every app runs in *your* Google account, and students' work saves to *your* Drive. Nothing is shared with me or anyone else.
- **You become the admin** of your copy the first time you run its setup function. From the app you can add other teachers at your school.
- **Canvas and AI feedback are optional.** Each teacher uses their own Canvas token and AI key.
- **Requires** a Google Workspace for Education account (students sign in with their school Google account).
